rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: Citing the CEC protocol of 5 April 2000 on the results of the presidential election (109,372,046 voters on the lists; 75,181,071 took part in the election, 68.74 per cent; 75,070,776 took part in the voting; registered candidate Putin Vladimir Vladimirovich 39,740,434 votes, 52.94 per cent), the CEC declares the election valid and deems 'Путина Владимира Владимировича' elected to the office of President of the Russian Federation, and orders publication in Rossiyskaya Gazeta, Parlamentskaya Gazeta and the CEC Vestnik. Headed 'Постановление ... от 5 апреля 2000 г. N 98/1110-3'; signed A. Veshnyakov (Chairman) and O. Zastrozhnaya (Secretary).

rows.role_title: Президент Российской Федерации — President of the Russian Federation
rows.text: The attached data give votes per registered candidate: Govorukhin 328,723 (0.44%), Dzhabrailov 78,498 (0.10%), Zhirinovsky 2,026,513 (2.70%), Zyuganov 21,928,471 (29.21%), Pamfilova 758,966 (1.01%), Podberezkin 98,175 (0.13%), Putin 39,740,434 (52.94%), Skuratov 319,263 (0.43%), Titov 1,107,269 (1.47%), Tuleev 2,217,361 (2.95%), Yavlinsky 4,351,452 (5.80%); against all 1,414,648 (1.88%).
